title: The ghs_APPID_JWT notation and the stateless header name in prose
summary: A sentence that writes the ghs_APPID_JWT notation and the X-GitHub-Stateless-S2S-Token header name with its enabled value.
rationale: Documentation and migration notes will repeat the notation and the header for months; both begin like the credential but hold none, the notation being shorter than the documented minimum and holding capital placeholder words.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. There is no token in the text. A project decision, pending a maintainer and a reviewer who is not the author.
